summary: Chilean Cobalt Corp. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026 disclosing a September 4 stock purchase agreement under which an existing investor, Madesal SpA, bought 750,000 common shares at $2.00 per share for $1,500,000 gross, issued under the Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D private-placement exemption. The same release noted completion of tranche 2 of the NeoRe SpA earn-in and option agreement. Proceeds are earmarked for district consolidation, exploration, early ESG work and working capital. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or close date was stated. This is a routine private financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and future earn-in tranches.
